description: Authorize Kitchn to send a restaurant's marketing email from its own domain (or from a subdomain such as news.yourdomain.com, passed as host): three DKIM CNAMEs so Amazon SES signs the mail in your name. Nothing else is added and no existing record is changed: no MX, SPF or DMARC.
variableDescription: %dkim1%, %dkim2%, %dkim3% - the three DKIM selectors Amazon SES assigns to the domain (32 lowercase alphanumerics each); each CNAME points to the same selector under dkim.amazonses.com.
